name: Katashiro Misao
source:
Single mother in her late thirties. She works mainly from home as a translator. She was raised with a strict upbringing and was baptized with rigid values from the time she was a child. Because of this, she is often seen as a cold person, but in fact she is very compassionate and loving.

After graduating from college, she had an arranged marriage partner, but her husband was unable to put up with her strictness and cheated on her, and the marriage fell apart within two years.

She has not healed from the emotional trauma of the divorce and vows never to fail again, but on the other hand, she is tired of her rigid lifestyle and has a desire to be dominated by a man of her own free will.

She has never known a man other than her husband, and has been frustrated because she has had no contact with the male sex for so long.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=826694&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
